newCandidatesThisWeek.rationale: Movement-first 1-second hook combined with bold text overlay in the same first frame is a distinct compound action: it requires a motion-trigger (visual change) synchronised with a text overlay render at frame 0 — different from existing edit_first_frame_text_hook (text only) and edit_bold_text_motion_hook (motion applied mid-video)

Hunting-niche before-after gear/trophy reveal requiring a specific POV cut structure (build-up → reveal moment → result) targeting field results, trophy reveals, and gear unboxings — extends edit_pov_transformation_cut with hunting-specific reveal sequencing and caption templates
1-3 minute TikTok format assembly is a distinct workflow: longer retention-arc pacing (chapter breaks at 30s intervals, re-hook mid-video) not covered by short-form tools which assume sub-60s clips

POV day-in-life hunting format requires a specific sequencing template (morning prep → field → result → recap) with time-of-day text cards and ambient audio transitions — a hunting-specific variant of generic day-in-life templates not in the current tool set

Deliberate 'unedited' style for TikTok requires a specific minimal-processing preset: single continuous take with natural audio, no music, no color grade, minimal caption, no transitions — the opposite of existing editing tools and a new style profile the Bridge does not currently have

Instagram's 2-second algorithm weight (vs TikTok's 3-second window) requires a tighter hook-timing profile: hook element must land by frame 48 (at 24fps) instead of frame 72 — this is a distinct timing-enforcement tool for Instagram-specific exports, not covered by existing hook tools which use 3-second benchmarks

LinkedIn raw founder video requires a distinct export profile: portrait crop with static frame, no music, no captions, no transitions, minimal color correction — signals authenticity to LinkedIn algorithm; a new style preset for the LinkedIn platform not covered by edit_reformat_for_linkedin (which handles layout only)

Serialized LinkedIn video series requires episode numbering overlays, a consistent intro/outro bumper template, and series-metadata tagging in the export — a recurring-format production workflow not in the existing toolset

Story-first branded documentary pacing for LinkedIn: slower cut rhythm (average 4-6 seconds per cut), B-roll-heavy structure, interview-style sound design, and narrative arc sequencing — distinct from all existing short-form hook-driven tools

summary: 9 new bridge tool candidates identified this week.
